relation: q^2 Du Dv = det J, q = k_c^2  (the onset relation for the critical wavenumber)
note: Checks that a committed critical wavenumber is the one the committed diffusivities and kinetic Jacobian imply at onset. 'violated' means those numbers are mutually inconsistent with the onset relation; it does NOT mean an observed pattern spacing is wrong, because on a finite domain the realised modes are quantised by the boundary conditions and away from onset the spacing is set by nonlinear mode competition. Tissue size deliberately does not appear among the inputs: that absence is the content of the law, not an omission.
